The device is also pictured with an extremely large heatsink :in these photos. This card is 3x3:3 for both 802.11ac (max. 1300Mbps PHY rate) :and 2.4GHz/5GHz 802.11n (max. 450Mbps PHY rate). The internal ''[[Arcadyan]]'' model name for the device appears :to be WN8222BAC-ASU (or maybe WN6222BAC-ASU). ===Reviews=== *[http://www.foxnetwork.ru/index.php/en/component/content/article/131-asus-pce-ac66.html Review on '''FoxNetwork'''] :WLAN: [[Broadcom]] [http://www.broadcom.com/products/Wireless-LAN/802.11-Wireless-LAN-Solutions/BCM4360 BCM4360KMLG] (3T3R 802.11abgn+ac) :OUI: 50:46:5D ===Drivers=== The driver provided by '''ASUS''' lists numerous devices which are :presumed to be 802.11ac capable. They are below... *14e4:43a0 (PCI ID of the BCM4360 used by the [[ASUS PCE-AC66]], : and the [[ASUS PCE-AC68]]) *14e4:43a1 *14e4:43a2 *14e4:43b1 (passys states that this is the ID.. but it seems :to be used by the BCM4352 based [[ASUS PCE-AC56]]) *14e4:43b2 *14e4:43b3 *14e4:4360

BCM4360_D11AC2G_ID	0x43a1    /* 4360 802.11ac 2.4G device */
BCM4360_D11AC5G_ID	0x43a2    /* 4360 802.11ac 5G device */
BCM4352_D11AC_ID	0x43b1    /* 4352 802.11ac dualband */

BCM43602_D11AC5G_ID	0x43bc    /* 43602 802.11ac 5G device */
